context: Final corrected full Run 1 comparison. The two-sample eyes-closed/early/proxy-touched subgroup is insufficient for interpretation; historical numeric values are preserved with this warning.

tail_sensitivity.limitation: Five-second scoring guards do not guarantee zero backward influence through zero-phase filtering. Tail intervention is not a new model prediction or a claimed correction.

historical_tail_sensitivity.limitation: Five-second scoring guards do not guarantee zero backward influence through zero-phase filtering. Tail intervention is not a new model prediction or a claimed correction.

model_comparison.primary: mean per-electrode NMSE, post-hoc one-session descriptive

spectrum.estimator: scipy.signal.welch; Hann 2s, 50% overlap, constant detrend; per-contiguous-interval PSDs weighted by complete Welch-window count

condition_comparison.inference: One session, not independent participants; no p-value or population inference.

production_report.interpretation: Post-hoc exploratory comparison: Zuna had higher mean normalized error than spherical-spline interpolation (Zuna 1.1756550684057796; spline 0.6750714228719527). Four measured electrodes were withheld. Completion does not remove original QC warnings or establish recovery of clean neural activity.
limitations: Experimental within-recording prediction benchmark, not proof of artifact removal, neural origin, diagnosis, thought decoding, or generalizable scientific validity. The recorded held-out signal is a comparison target, not clean ground truth.
Explicit post-hoc exploratory recipe: the original frozen endpoint remains NOT ESTIMABLE; original BENCH and QC records remain unchanged.
Actual electrode mapping is an operator declaration, not independent measured proof. Legacy aliases T3/T4/T5/T6 map to T7/T8/P7/P8 template coordinates.
Original calibration is excluded, not repaired. The fixed pretrained model uses retained-only per-window normalization; no fitted calibration or target-informed selection.
Log-derived host receipt approximation, not independently calibrated ADC/display latency; no waveform alignment fitting, gap filling or original timestamp edits.
Each observed block is independently resampled and filtered; no computation crosses an inter-block or acquisition gap. Five seconds at each block edge are excluded.

Versioned offline boundary-safe preparation independently removes each channel block mean before line-padded resampling. This is a new derivative, not historical execution replay or a change to the frozen recipe. It is noncausal and does not eliminate every edge transient or model seam.
All branches receive the same fixed post-prediction 0.5–40Hz filter; measured and spline branches consequently have two filter passes. Unfiltered generated arrays are retained.
Five-second independent model contexts may produce seams; this is a PRAYCG operationalization, not an exact reproduction of the upstream paper.
Condition labels follow software observations; actual acoustic onset and eye-state compliance were not independently measured.
No inferential p-value, clean-brain claim, automatic artifact removal or participant-data promotion is permitted.
RAW_CONTAINER: Timestamp gaps exceed the frozen multiple of the expected sampling interval.
PROTOCOL_WINDOW: Timestamp gaps exceed the frozen multiple of the expected sampling interval.

methods.reference: Zuna technical report arXiv:2602.18478; pinned ZUNA1.1 PRAYCG adapter, not exact paper evaluation

numerical_preparation_policy.offset_removal: Independent full-preparation-interval arithmetic mean per channel, before resampling; offsets not restored
numerical_preparation_policy.target_isolation: Each target is centered/filtered independently; target values or statistics never enter retained inputs or reference
numerical_preparation_policy.preparation_filter: scipy.signal.butter order4 bandpass 0.5-40 Hz at 256 Hz; scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt default odd extension
numerical_preparation_policy.timestamp_policy: Unchanged source-fractional-index interpolation; no time shift, gap filling or waveform alignment
numerical_preparation_policy.comparison_filter: Unchanged common post-prediction order4 0.5-40 Hz zero-phase pass on measured/spline/Zuna branches
numerical_preparation_policy.model_context_policy: Unchanged five-second independent contexts and existing reflected-tail behavior
numerical_preparation_policy.evaluation_mask_policy: Unchanged caller-governed exclusions; no amplitude- or outcome-selected exclusion
numerical_preparation_policy.limitation: Linear endpoint extension and centering mitigate DC-padding artifacts, not all filter transients or model seams; not a live/causal implementation

timing.limitation: Log-derived host receipt approximation, not independently calibrated ADC/display latency; no waveform alignment fitting, gap filling or original timestamp edits.

preparation.normalization: Per five-second model context, retained-only scalar statistics; no target signals or fitted calibration.

model.spatial_encoding: Pinned FIF-default parity: float32 arithmetic, integer truncation, 100 bins from -0.12 to +0.12 m. Not proof of training coordinates; no geometric rescale.
model.normalization: Per-window single mean and population standard deviation from retained channels only; scale to std 0.1; target tokens exactly zero. Apply inverse scalar transformation from retained channels only. No additional re-reference or filter.
model.upstream_pipeline_difference: Uses the pinned low-level model sample API; deliberately does not use upstream per-channel normalization, automatic average reference, filtering, masking heuristics, or seam corrections. This is a PRAYCG experimental operationalization, not an exact reproduction of the published evaluation.
model.context_seam_limitation: Independent model contexts and reflected final padding can affect spectra and errors; no hidden-target seam anchoring is permitted.
model.license_review_limitation: The wheel includes Meta copyright headers and an Llama 2 notice in eeg_eval.py alongside project Apache-2.0 metadata. PRAYCG does not redistribute the wheel or weights, does not overwrite notices, and does not claim comprehensive upstream provenance clearance.

detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.input: retained measured Fp1 only; no hidden targets or predictions
detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.filter: second-order Butterworth 0.5-8 Hz, forward/backward independently per block
detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.half_prominence_width: recorded, not used to select events

strata_definition.inclusion_policy: Primary full comparison retains every original eligible sample; no category is an exclusion.
strata_definition.empty_or_short_stratum_policy: Report sample count and NOT_ESTIMABLE when required statistics lack support; never replace intervals or change thresholds.
strata_definition.spectral_policy: Only complete, contiguous within-block Welch windows wholly inside the descriptive mask; never concatenate disjoint mask pieces. Record usable windows/coverage.
limitations: The proxy was computed on historical preparation, which had a demonstrated boundary artifact; frozen labels are imperfect historical categories, not corrected-input blink detection.
Proxy-untouched and outside-local-proxy do not mean artifact-free or clean neural ground truth.
All proxy parameters, events and masks are reused, not retuned using corrected model output.
Early means relative seconds [5,20); later means [20, original eligible endpoint], including original eligible samples slightly beyond nominal second55.
The older audit late_20_55 denominator was slightly shorter; this plan explicitly uses the full original eligible late interval and recounts only already-frozen event indices.
Event rates within proxy-conditioned categories are mathematically conditioned by their definition; not estimates of physiological blink prevalence.
Counts/256 are sample-equivalent durations on the model grid, not claims of independently verified physical timing.
Forty-five overlapping descriptive intersections are not independent replications or multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests; no p-values or outcome-based exclusions.
No original report, recipe, recording, installed application or previous evaluation score is changed.
Post-hoc, single-recording development comparison. Historical BENCH status is preserved. No participant-data promotion or prospective validation.
Withheld measured EEG is not clean neural ground truth. Reproducing or disagreeing with ocular contamination is not proof of neural preservation or artifact removal.

The original fixed frontal proxy was calculated before this corrected comparison, on the old preparation. It is a noisy historical stratifier, not verified blinks; untouched does not mean clean. No outcome-selected exclusion is made.

Eyes-open/closed labels follow software observations, not independently measured compliance. Timing is approximate without independent ALS-barcode validation; template positions include disclosed Cz/Pz coordinate clipping.

Full-block centering and zero-phase filtering use future samples; this is offline/noncausal, not live-ready processing. Independent five-second model contexts and reflected final padding can introduce seams.

The primary production endpoint applies the same post-prediction filter to every branch, but measured/spline signals already had preparation filtering while model output did not. The mandatory precomparison companion is reported without choosing the favorable endpoint.

Both prepared inputs and comparison targets changed after the boundary correction. Old/new absolute error differences are not an isolated measure of model improvement against an unchanged clean target.
All blocks, channels and declared strata are retained regardless of winner. Repeated windows/channels are not independent participants; no significance or clinical-validity claim is made.
Private EEG-derived outputs require separate privacy review before sharing. The installed Workbench, original XDF, recipe and historical results remain unchanged.
